A mind-first foundation unifies the observed mental and ordered features.
Dependent reality requires a non-dependent basis.
Removing arbitrary limits supports a supreme nature.

Design predictions are too vague to select it over rivals.
No infinite non-extensive magnitude or maximum power exists.
A multiverse raises observer-relative life evidence.
Ultimate reality need not have a further explanation.
Observed suffering conflicts with a powerful good creator.
